features.label: Wrote America from exile
features.detail: Left for France to see it clearly. Most of the great essays on America were written outside it.

features.label: A preacher's cadence
features.detail: Started in the pulpit at fourteen. The rhythm never left, and it is why the essays land physically.

features.label: Refused the comfortable position
features.detail: Attacked allies as sharply as opponents. Endlessly quotable and never safe.
